svg.title: A monomial of weight at most five has at most two fields, since each variable has weight at least two. With two fields its jet orders are either (0, 0) or (0, 1); the latter has weight five. Decompose a polynomial into its constant, linear and these quadratic pieces by ordinary field number and engineering weight. Invariance of each piece follows from the linearity of the color action. The linear piece vanishes by (FC1). Polarizing the (0, 0) piece, and separating the two jet orders in the (0, 1) piece, gives invariant bilinear forms. Resolve their spatial tensor coordinates; (FC1) then makes every color contraction a multiple of the color inner product. Consequently all weight-four labels are spanned by the unit and ⟨Fab, Fcd⟩; through weight five one adds ⟨Fab, ∂eFcd⟩. This is a spanning assertion about the actual invariant labels before further free equation relations. Put Qab,cd = P c F c abF c cd, with products interpreted as in (FM3), and define
